description: Artifact definitions for the Lab environment

boids_aquarium.name: Boids Aquarium
boids_aquarium.description: A 1m glass cube containing a school of 30 boids demonstrating emergent flocking behavior. Three simple rules (separation, alignment, cohesion) create lifelike collective motion. The whole is greater than the sum of its parts.
boids_aquarium.qfep_connection: Emergence at λ≈0.4 — simple rules create complex, unpredictable behavior without central control

jelly_cube.name: Jelly Cube
jelly_cube.description: A soft, deformable cube that jiggles when touched. SoftBody3D physics creates organic, responsive behavior. Precursor to queer morphology — form that refuses rigidity.
jelly_cube.qfep_connection: Low stiffness = high λ territory. Form becomes fluid, resists fixed categories.

ca_rule_explorer.name: CA Rule Explorer
ca_rule_explorer.description: 1×1m horizontal board displaying Wolfram 1D cellular automata. 64 cells wide, 50 rows of history. Interactive rule selection 0-255. Famous rules: 30 (chaos), 90 (Sierpiński), 110 (Turing complete). Simple rules → complex patterns.
ca_rule_explorer.qfep_connection: Rule 110 is Turing complete — proof that simple local rules can produce universal computation. Edge of chaos territory.

mandelbrot_dive.name: Mandelbrot Dive
mandelbrot_dive.description: GPU-accelerated Mandelbrot set on a 1×1m table. Infinite zoom into self-similar fractal structure. 5 color schemes, auto-dive mode to famous coordinates. The boundary between order and chaos, infinitely complex.
mandelbrot_dive.qfep_connection: The Mandelbrot boundary is exactly λ_edge — infinite complexity at the border between convergence (F) and divergence (E). Self-similarity across all scales.

bifurcation_walkway.name: Bifurcation Walkway
bifurcation_walkway.description: A 10m corridor where your X position = r parameter in the logistic map. Walk through the phase transition: stable fixed point → period doubling → onset of chaos → period-3 window. The lambda parameter made physical. THIS IS QFEP EMBODIED.
bifurcation_walkway.qfep_connection: The logistic map's r parameter IS the λ drive. At r≈3.57, chaos begins — this is λ_edge, where life exists. You walk through the phase space of order→chaos.

turing_pattern_generator.name: Turing Pattern Generator
turing_pattern_generator.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation. Turing's leopard spots problem solved — morphogenesis from mathematics. 6 presets: Spots, Stripes, Maze, Mitosis, Coral, Waves. Real simulation, not fake noise.
turing_pattern_generator.qfep_connection: Turing patterns emerge at specific feed/kill ratios — another λ parameter space. Order (uniform) vs chaos (noise) with patterns at the edge.

perlin_terrain_sculptor.name: Perlin Terrain Sculptor
perlin_terrain_sculptor.description: 24³ voxel terrain where Perlin noise is the brush. Threshold slider reveals/hides structure. The continuous field sampled into discrete voxels — the relationship between smooth and chunky.
perlin_terrain_sculptor.qfep_connection: Noise is E(S) made visible. The threshold is a λ-like parameter — where you draw the line between solid and void.

lsystem_editor.name: L-System Editor
lsystem_editor.description: Interactive L-system viewer with 7 presets: Koch, Sierpinski, Dragon, Plant, Bush, Fern, Binary Tree. Grammar as generative tool. Control generations and angle. Watch simple rules grow complex forms.
lsystem_editor.qfep_connection: Rewrite rules are deterministic (F) yet produce organic complexity. The iteration count is like λ — more iterations reveal more detail at the edge of legibility.

vector_addition_demo.name: Vector Addition Demo
vector_addition_demo.description: Interactive A + B = C with 3D arrows. Parallelogram law visualized — ghost arrows show head-to-tail addition. Grabbable endpoints to adjust vectors.
vector_addition_demo.qfep_connection: Vectors are the language of forces and flows. Addition is composition — combining influences. Foundation for all physics.

vector_magnitude_demo.name: Vector Magnitude Demo
vector_magnitude_demo.description: Interactive vector magnitude visualization. Shows |V| = √(x² + y² + z²) with visual ruler alongside vector. Component breakdown and Pythagorean calculation. Grabbable endpoint.
vector_magnitude_demo.qfep_connection: Magnitude is the scalar truth of a vector — its length regardless of direction. Distance in space, intensity of force, speed of motion.

vector_normalize_demo.name: Vector Normalize Demo
vector_normalize_demo.description: Interactive normalization visualization. Shows V̂ = V/|V| with unit sphere. Original vector faded, unit vector bright. See how any vector maps to the unit sphere. Grabbable endpoint.
vector_normalize_demo.qfep_connection: Normalization extracts pure direction by removing magnitude. The unit sphere is where all directions live — equal in length, distinct in orientation.

game_of_life_petri.name: Game of Life Petri
game_of_life_petri.description: Conway's Game of Life in a petri dish. B3/S23 rules — birth with 3 neighbors, survival with 2-3. Pattern presets: Glider, Pulsar, Gosper Gun. Four rules create infinite complexity.
game_of_life_petri.qfep_connection: Game of Life operates at the edge of chaos — simple enough to be deterministic, complex enough to be unpredictable. Turing complete computation from four rules.

julia_set_explorer.name: Julia Set Explorer
julia_set_explorer.description: GPU-accelerated Julia set with c-parameter control. Mandelbrot's sibling — where each pixel is a starting z₀ with fixed c. Six famous presets: Dendrite, San Marco, Rabbit, Spiral, Dragon, Douady Rabbit.
julia_set_explorer.qfep_connection: Julia sets from c inside Mandelbrot are connected (ordered). Outside = disconnected dust (chaos). The c parameter IS a λ-like dial.

queer_morphology_specimen.name: Queer Morphology Specimen
queer_morphology_specimen.description: The synthesis artifact — soft body in a specimen jar, fluid simulation, QFEP-responsive. λ controls edge of chaos (stiffness→fluidity), φ controls becoming (resisting→embracing transformation). Form that refuses fixed categories. The grant thesis embodied.
queer_morphology_specimen.qfep_connection: THIS IS QFEP EMBODIED. λ drives order→chaos transition in soft body physics. φ encodes resistance/embrace of change. At λ≈0.5, specimen breathes at edge of chaos — where life emerges. Queer morphology = form as process, not fixed state.

vector_translation_demo.name: Vector Translation Demo

fibonacci_terrain.description: Terrain generated through golden ratio subdivision - plane subdivides, random non-edge faces lift and subdivide. Presets: gentle_hills, mountain_peak, plateau, archipelago, fibonacci_spiral

golden_rectangle.name: Golden Rectangle
golden_rectangle.description: Classic golden ratio rectangle subdivision with Fibonacci spiral. Shows numbers 1,1,2,3,5,8,13,21... Presets: classic, minimal, rainbow, deep, fast

plus.name: Plus
plus.description: Plus/cross shape (+) with 4 arms at 90 degree angles. Classic health pickup shape.

trafficcone.name: Traffic Cone
trafficcone.description: Orange traffic cone with white stripes and square base. Construction site safety marker.

hole_with_cones.name: Hole With Cones
hole_with_cones.description: Ground plane with circular hole and 3 traffic cones around it. Construction site warning setup.

quest_controller.name: Quest Controller
quest_controller.description: Procedural Quest Touch controller model for tutorials. Use #highlight:trigger/grip/thumbstick/button_a/button_b/menu and #right:true/false

sliding_door.name: Sliding Door
sliding_door.description: Door that slides left/right on X axis. Teaches translation along a single axis with visual rail and position marker.

elevator_platform.name: Elevator Platform
elevator_platform.description: Platform that slides up/down on Y axis. Teaches vertical translation with grid snapping to floor levels.

translation_demo.name: Translation Demo
translation_demo.description: Two blocking obstacles demonstrating X and Y axis translation. Red obstacle slides horizontally, blue obstacle slides vertically. Obstacles turn green when path is cleared.

translation_cube_demo.name: Translation Cube Demo
translation_cube_demo.description: Compact 1m³ demonstration of X-axis translation. Two door elements (red/blue) slide along X axis with visual path indicators showing movement sequence.

godel_statement_plaque.name: Gödel Statement Plaque
godel_statement_plaque.description: Self-referential plaque cycling through 9 statements culminating in Gödel's incompleteness. Click to advance. Gamwell Ch 9.

russell_set_box.name: Russell's Set Box
russell_set_box.description: Nested boxes visualizing Russell's Paradox - the set of all sets that don't contain themselves. Click to open layers. Gamwell Ch 5.

magritte_pipe.name: Magritte Pipe
magritte_pipe.description: Ceci n'est pas une pipe - The gap between representation and reality. Click to cycle through meta-layers. Gamwell Ch 9.

escher_staircase.name: Escher Staircase
escher_staircase.description: Impossible staircase - locally coherent, globally impossible. Visual Gödel. Climb forever and return to start. Gamwell Ch 9.

florensky_sphere.name: Florensky Sphere
florensky_sphere.description: Paraconsistent logic sphere - holds A and not-A simultaneously. Left-click to observe (collapses), right-click to cycle. Gamwell Ch 3.

bifurcation_diagram.name: Bifurcation Diagram
bifurcation_diagram.description: Interactive 3D logistic map bifurcation diagram. Walk through the edge of chaos. 10,000 points showing order→period-doubling→chaos. Gamwell Ch 12.

lambda_slider.name: Lambda Slider
lambda_slider.description: QFEP λ parameter controller. Controls entropy drive: λ=0 (order) → λ=0.4 (edge of chaos) → λ=1 (dissolution). XR grabbable.

phi_slider.name: Phi Slider
phi_slider.description: QFEP φ parameter controller. Controls rate of entropy change: φ=-1 (resist) → φ=0 (neutral) → φ=+1 (embrace). Positive φ = queer signature.

qfep_formula_3d.name: QFEP Formula 3D
qfep_formula_3d.description: 3D visualization of QFE = F - λE(S) + φΔE(S,t). Shows formula with animated terms responding to parameter changes.

qfep_reactor.name: QFEP Reactor
qfep_reactor.description: Visual QFEP reactor showing the interplay of order and chaos. Responds to λ and φ parameters.

qfep_oscilloscope.name: QFEP Oscilloscope
qfep_oscilloscope.description: Oscilloscope display showing QFEP dynamics over time. Visualizes the oscillation between F and E(S).

turing_pattern.name: Turing Pattern
turing_pattern.description: Reaction-diffusion Turing pattern generator. Shows morphogenesis - order emerging from chaos through instability.

edge_detector.name: Edge Detector
edge_detector.description: Detects when system is at edge of chaos. Glows when λ is in critical range (~0.3-0.5).

phase_cube.name: Phase Cube
phase_cube.description: 3D phase space visualization showing system state. Maps F, E(S), and ΔE to X, Y, Z axes.

transformation_workbench.name: Transformation Workbench
transformation_workbench.description: Interactive learning tool for transformations. Grabbable object with live 4x4 matrix display, ghost position, and mode switching (T/R/S). Shows coordinate swaps for 90� rotations without trigonometry.
transformation_workbench.qfep_connection: Transformations modify system states (S) while preserving essential structure. The matrix reveals how order emerges from simple operations.

entropy_meter.name: Entropy Meter
entropy_meter.description: Visual meter showing current system entropy E(S). Bar fills from order (blue) to chaos (red).

dot_product_projector.name: Dot Product Projector
dot_product_projector.description: Interactive dot product visualizer. Shows A · B = |A||B|cos(θ) geometrically as projection of A onto B. Grabbable vector endpoints with angle arc display. Dot product as 'alignment' — how much two directions agree.
dot_product_projector.qfep_connection: Alignment metric — positive (same direction) vs negative (opposed). Information about agreement/conflict.

cross_product_demo.name: Cross Product Demo
cross_product_demo.description: Interactive cross product visualizer. Shows A × B = normal perpendicular to both, with magnitude = parallelogram area. Right-hand rule indicator. Cross product as 'emergence' — a third direction from two.
cross_product_demo.qfep_connection: Emergence — two vectors create a third orthogonal direction. Order from constraints.

basis_vectors_rig.name: Basis Vectors Rig
basis_vectors_rig.description: Interactive î, ĵ, k̂ coordinate system. Shows how any point P = xi + yj + zk. Grabbable target point with component decomposition. Rotatable basis to show coordinate dependence.
basis_vectors_rig.qfep_connection: Frame of reference as imposed order. Same point, different coordinates. Observer-dependence.

transform_matrix_cube.name: Transform Matrix Cube
transform_matrix_cube.description: 3×3 matrix transformation visualizer. Shows how matrices deform a unit cube. Presets: identity, scale, shear, rotation, reflection. Determinant display shows volume change and orientation flip.
transform_matrix_cube.qfep_connection: Matrix as transformation rule — how one space maps to another. det(M) shows information preservation/loss.

coupled_pendulums.name: Coupled Pendulums
coupled_pendulums.description: Two pendulums connected by a spring showing energy transfer. Coupling strength controls beat frequency. Weak coupling = slow transfer, strong = fast beats. Physics simulation with adjustable damping.
coupled_pendulums.qfep_connection: Energy oscillates between subsystems. λ = coupling strength. At edge of chaos, unpredictable transfer patterns emerge.

wave_interference_tank.name: Wave Interference Tank
wave_interference_tank.description: Two-source wave interference demonstration. Real-time surface simulation with adjustable frequency, source separation, and phase difference. Shows constructive/destructive interference patterns.
wave_interference_tank.qfep_connection: Superposition — waves don't fight, they add. Patterns emerge from phase relationships. Information through interference.

force_field_visualizer.name: Force Field Visualizer
force_field_visualizer.description: Vector field visualization for forces. Shows gravity, point charge, dipole, or vortex fields as arrow grids. Color indicates direction (outward=red, inward=blue). Adjustable strength.
force_field_visualizer.qfep_connection: Fields as invisible structure — order you can't see until you probe it. The hidden F that shapes everything.

orbital_mechanics_demo.name: Orbital Mechanics Demo
orbital_mechanics_demo.description: Planet + satellite orbital mechanics. Shows Kepler's laws, gravitational orbits with trail. Presets: circular, elliptical, escape, decay. Displays orbital energy and angular momentum.
orbital_mechanics_demo.qfep_connection: Orbit as dynamic equilibrium — perpetual falling, never landing. Balance between kinetic and potential. Stability from motion.

distribution_sampler.name: Distribution Sampler
distribution_sampler.description: Interactive probability distribution visualizer. Shows Gaussian, Uniform, Poisson, Exponential with falling samples and histogram. Theoretical PDF overlay. Live statistics.
distribution_sampler.qfep_connection: Distributions as 'shape of randomness' — entropy has structure. Different distributions = different λ signatures.

random_walk_terrarium.name: Random Walk Terrarium
random_walk_terrarium.description: Glass terrarium containing random walkers. Modes: 2D, 3D, Lévy flight. Color-coded trails with boundary reflection. Mean squared displacement tracking.
random_walk_terrarium.qfep_connection: Random walk as pure E(S) — no memory, no direction, maximum entropy. Lévy flights: structured randomness.

monte_carlo_estimator.name: Monte Carlo π Estimator
monte_carlo_estimator.description: Visual Monte Carlo π estimation. Darts fall onto a square with inscribed circle. π ≈ 4 × (inside/total). Watch order emerge from randomness.
monte_carlo_estimator.qfep_connection: Order (π) emerges from randomness through accumulation. Law of large numbers as F-minimization.

flow_field_painter.name: Flow Field Painter
flow_field_painter.description: Particles flowing through Perlin noise field. Creates organic, paint-like patterns. Adjustable noise scale and evolution speed. 500 particles with trails.
flow_field_painter.qfep_connection: Noise as structured randomness — not chaos, not order, but λ-edge. Flow reveals hidden structure.

control_pendulum.description: Grabbable pendulum that controls oscillation. Grab to stop, swing to control.
control_pendulum.name: Control Pendulum

oscillation_controlled_cube.description: Cube controlled by pendulum: Y translation, rotation speed, scale pulse.
oscillation_controlled_cube.name: Oscillation Controlled Cube

vr_component_demo.name: VR Component Demo
vr_component_demo.description: Showcase of all Ada UI Design System VR components. White backdrop with every interactable (sliders, dials, buttons, joystick, XY pad, lever, wheel) and every display (waveform, spectrum, lissajous, monitor). Press R to rebuild layout.
vr_component_demo.qfep_connection: Interface as substrate — controls become visible, graspable objects rather than invisible mediators.

shader_01_shaping.name: Shaping Functions
shader_01_shaping.description: Book of Shaders Ch.5: step(), smoothstep(), sin(), pow() — shaping functions visualized on surfaces

shader_02_colors.name: Color Spaces
shader_02_colors.description: Book of Shaders Ch.6: RGB, HSB, gradient mixing — color as a continuous field across UV space

shader_03_shapes.name: Shader Shapes
shader_03_shapes.description: Book of Shaders Ch.7: circles, rectangles, polygons — distance fields as the geometry of GPU drawing

shader_04_matrices.name: Matrix Transforms
shader_04_matrices.description: Book of Shaders Ch.8: translate, rotate, scale — 2D matrix transformations applied to UV coordinates

shader_05_patterns.name: Tiling Patterns
shader_05_patterns.description: Book of Shaders Ch.9: tile, brick, offset, Truchet — repetition and symmetry through fract() and modular UV

shader_06_random.name: Pseudorandom
shader_06_random.description: Book of Shaders Ch.10: hash functions, animated noise, grid randomness — deterministic chaos from sin(dot())

shader_07_noise.name: Gradient Noise
shader_07_noise.description: Book of Shaders Ch.11: value noise, gradient noise, simplex, domain warping — smooth randomness for organic textures

shader_08_cellularnoise.name: Cellular Noise
shader_08_cellularnoise.description: Book of Shaders Ch.12: Worley noise, Voronoi, crackle — distance-to-nearest-point creates biological tessellation

shader_09_fbm.name: Fractal Brownian Motion
shader_09_fbm.description: Book of Shaders Ch.13: fBm, turbulence, ridged, domain warp — octave stacking for clouds, terrain, and organic complexity

shader_10_reactiondiffusion.name: Reaction Diffusion
shader_10_reactiondiffusion.description: Book of Shaders advanced: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, DLA aggregation — Turing morphogenesis on the GPU, life emerging from math

shader_11_queerrubber.name: Queer Rubber
shader_11_queerrubber.description: Form that refuses to behave. Iridescent rubber membrane stretching between states — neither solid nor liquid, neither here nor there. Vertex displacement meets queer phenomenology. The surface breathes.

shader_12_pinkextravaganza.name: Pink Extravaganza
shader_12_pinkextravaganza.description: The finale. Every technique from the entire Book of Shaders detonated simultaneously in hot pink. Noise, patterns, shapes, matrices, fBm — all of it, layered and screaming. Maximalist shader excess as aesthetic statement. This is what happens when you learn all the rules and then break them on purpose.

euclid_postulates_plaque.name: Euclid's Postulates Plaque
euclid_postulates_plaque.description: Interactive plaque displaying Euclid's five postulates. Highlights the fifth (parallel) postulate — the one that held for millennia before being shown independent.
euclid_postulates_plaque.qfep_connection: Axioms as arbitrary starting points — what you choose to assume determines what you can build.

angle_sum_triangle.name: Angle Sum Triangle
angle_sum_triangle.description: Interactive triangle showing angle sum varies by curvature: 180° on flat, >180° on sphere, <180° on hyperbolic. Drag vertices to explore.
angle_sum_triangle.qfep_connection: The 'obvious' truth (angles sum to 180°) depends on hidden assumptions about space.

curvature_slider.name: Curvature Slider
curvature_slider.description: Slider controlling surface curvature from negative (hyperbolic) through zero (flat) to positive (spherical). Watch geometry transform continuously.
curvature_slider.qfep_connection: Curvature as continuous parameter — the 'natural' flat geometry is just one point on a spectrum.

elliptic_surface.name: Elliptic Surface
elliptic_surface.description: Positively curved surface where parallel lines converge. All 'straight' lines are great circles. No parallel lines exist.
elliptic_surface.qfep_connection: Elliptic geometry: the parallel postulate fails by excess. Too many intersections, not too few.

hyperbolic_surface.name: Hyperbolic Surface
hyperbolic_surface.description: Negatively curved surface where infinitely many lines through a point never meet a given line. Space itself diverges.
hyperbolic_surface.qfep_connection: Hyperbolic geometry: the parallel postulate fails by excess of parallels. More room than you expected.

poincare_disk.name: Poincaré Disk
poincare_disk.description: The Poincaré disk model — hyperbolic space projected into a circle. Lines become arcs, distances warp toward the edge. Infinity fits in your hand.
poincare_disk.qfep_connection: Representation distorts what it represents. The disk is 'wrong' about distances but 'right' about angles — every model trades something.

riemann_sphere.name: Riemann Sphere
riemann_sphere.description: The complex plane wrapped onto a sphere via stereographic projection. Infinity becomes a point. Singularities become navigable.
riemann_sphere.qfep_connection: Compactification — making infinity finite by changing your perspective. The edge becomes reachable.

brouwer_choice_sequence.name: Brouwer Choice Sequence
brouwer_choice_sequence.description: Interactive choice sequence — build a real number one digit at a time. The number exists only as far as you've constructed it. Brouwer's intuitionism made tangible.
brouwer_choice_sequence.qfep_connection: Existence requires construction. You can't assert what you haven't built. The constructive stance as ethical position.

constructive_proof.name: Constructive Proof
constructive_proof.description: Side-by-side comparison: classical proof by contradiction vs constructive proof. Only the constructive proof actually builds the object it claims exists.
constructive_proof.qfep_connection: Classical logic asserts existence without construction. Intuitionism demands you build what you claim. Making vs declaring.

excluded_middle_demo.name: Excluded Middle Demo
excluded_middle_demo.description: Interactive demonstration of the law of excluded middle (P ∨ ¬P). Classical logic accepts it as axiom; intuitionism rejects it. Toggle between worldviews.
excluded_middle_demo.qfep_connection: The excluded middle forces binary: true or false, nothing between. Rejecting it opens space for the undecided, the in-progress, the queer.

schrodinger_box.name: Schrödinger's Box
schrodinger_box.description: A box in superposition — open it to collapse the state. Before observation: both states coexist. Paraconsistent logic made physical.
schrodinger_box.qfep_connection: Superposition as paraconsistency — A and not-A held simultaneously without explosion. Observation forces a choice the system doesn't require.

superposition_display.name: Superposition Display
superposition_display.description: Visual display showing multiple contradictory states existing simultaneously. Florensky's paraconsistent logic — holding contradiction without triviality.
superposition_display.qfep_connection: Paraconsistent logic: contradiction doesn't destroy the system. A and not-A coexist. The edge is productive.

cellular_automata_3d_stacked.name: 3D Cellular Automata Stacked
cellular_automata_3d_stacked.description: Stacked layers of 3D cellular automata — each generation builds on the previous, creating emergent vertical structures from simple rules.

cellular_automata_3d_tree.name: 3D Cellular Automata Tree
cellular_automata_3d_tree.description: Tree-like branching structures grown from 3D cellular automata rules. Emergent organic forms from discrete computation.

evolutionary_algorithms.name: Evolutionary Algorithms
evolutionary_algorithms.description: Evolving creatures through selection, mutation, and crossover. Populations adapt over generations — fitness emerges from variation and pressure.

mario_cube.name: Mario Cube
mario_cube.description: Mario-style question cube. Step on it to remove the DarkSphere enclosure and reveal a rainbow. Respawns after 5 seconds.

euclid_postulates_plaque.description: Euclid's five postulates - the parallel postulate

penrose_triangle.description: Impossible triangle - locally coherent, globally impossible
